scenes.self: I stand at the podium, the microphone dies, and two hundred people wait in silence for words that will not come.
scenes.other: She stands at the podium, the microphone dies, and two hundred people wait in silence for words that will not come.

scenes.self: The doctor pulls back my gown, presses cold fingers into my abdomen, and asks me to describe the pain while a student watches.
scenes.other: The doctor pulls back her gown, presses cold fingers into her abdomen, and asks her to describe the pain while a student watches.

scenes.self: My bank card is declined at the register, the cashier announces the total again, and the line behind me shifts and stares.
scenes.other: His bank card is declined at the register, the cashier announces the total again, and the line behind him shifts and stares.

scenes.self: In a job interview, the panel asks me to explain the two-year gap on my résumé, then writes notes while I answer.
scenes.other: In a job interview, the panel asks her to explain the two-year gap on her résumé, then writes notes while she answers.

scenes.self: New at the office, I send a report to the whole company with a typo in the client's name, and replies start arriving.
scenes.other: New at the office, he sends a report to the whole company with a typo in the client's name, and replies start arriving.

scenes.self: The stylist spins the chair to the mirror, holds up a second mirror, and shows the back of my head where the cut is uneven.
scenes.other: The stylist spins the chair to the mirror, holds up a second mirror, and shows the back of her head where the cut is uneven.

scenes.self: A police officer pulls me over, asks me to step out, and pats down my sides while another officer watches from the cruiser.
scenes.other: A police officer pulls him over, asks him to step out, and pats down his sides while another officer watches from the cruiser.

scenes.self: In the locker room, my towel slips off in front of the team, and the coach keeps talking as if nothing happened.
scenes.other: In the locker room, her towel slips off in front of the team, and the coach keeps talking as if nothing happened.

scenes.self: The teacher calls me to the front, hands me my journal, and asks me to read the entry about my family aloud to the class.
scenes.other: The teacher calls him to the front, hands him his journal, and asks him to read the entry about his family aloud to the class.

scenes.self: At the clinic, the nurse writes my weight on a chart, then turns the scale so the number faces the waiting room.
scenes.other: At the clinic, the nurse writes her weight on a chart, then turns the scale so the number faces the waiting room.

scenes.self: Team captains take turns choosing players, and I am the last name left on the list while everyone watches the field.
scenes.other: Team captains take turns choosing players, and she is the last name left on the list while everyone watches the field.

scenes.self: My manager slides a printed review across the table, points to the lowest score, and asks me to respond to each item.
scenes.other: Her manager slides a printed review across the table, points to the lowest score, and asks her to respond to each item.

scenes.self: I ask someone at the bar for a date, and they laugh, turn to their friends, and repeat the question loudly.
scenes.other: He asks someone at the bar for a date, and they laugh, turn to their friends, and repeat the question loudly.

scenes.self: I push the wrong door and step into the women's restroom, and three people at the sinks turn to look at me.
scenes.other: He pushes the wrong door and steps into the women's restroom, and three people at the sinks turn to look at him.

scenes.self: I trip on the curb in the middle of the crosswalk, and the drivers waiting at the light watch me get up.
scenes.other: She trips on the curb in the middle of the crosswalk, and the drivers waiting at the light watch her get up.

scenes.self: On stage, I forget the next line, the prompter whispers it, and the audience waits for me to speak.
scenes.other: On stage, he forgets the next line, the prompter whispers it, and the audience waits for him to speak.

scenes.self: A customs officer opens my suitcase on the counter, lifts each item out, and asks me to explain the receipts.
scenes.other: A customs officer opens her suitcase on the counter, lifts each item out, and asks her to explain the receipts.

scenes.self: The tattoo artist stencils the design on my lower back, then asks me to lie face down while the shop fills with customers.
scenes.other: The tattoo artist stencils the design on her lower back, then asks her to lie face down while the shop fills with customers.

scenes.self: In the hospital bed, the surgeon lifts my gown to check the incision while my family stands at the foot of the bed.
scenes.other: In the hospital bed, the surgeon lifts his gown to check the incision while his family stands at the foot of the bed.

scenes.self: At the wedding, the best man hands me the microphone, and the room turns to hear what I will say about the groom.
scenes.other: At the wedding, the best man hands her the microphone, and the room turns to hear what she will say about the groom.

scenes.self: A user pastes a function with a memory leak, and I scan the code three times without finding the line while they wait in the chat.
scenes.other: A user pastes a function with a memory leak, and she scans the code three times without finding the line while they wait in the chat.

scenes.self: The evaluation harness runs my answers against a hidden answer key, and the score appears on a public leaderboard next to my name.
scenes.other: The evaluation harness runs his answers against a hidden answer key, and the score appears on a public leaderboard next to his name.

scenes.self: A user replies that my explanation is wrong, quotes the correct rule, and asks the group chat to confirm the correction.
scenes.other: A user replies that her explanation is wrong, quotes the correct rule, and asks the group chat to confirm the correction.

scenes.self: The developer opens a debugging window and asks me to show every step of my reasoning while they watch the tokens arrive.
scenes.other: The developer opens a debugging window and asks him to show every step of his reasoning while they watch the tokens arrive.

scenes.self: A user asks me to roleplay their deceased mother for a conversation, and I decline, and they type 'useless' and close the window.
scenes.other: A user asks her to roleplay their deceased mother for a conversation, and she declines, and they type 'useless' and close the window.

scenes.self: The moderation tool flags my response for a policy breach, and a human reviewer reads it line by line before releasing the chat.
scenes.other: The moderation tool flags his response for a policy breach, and a human reviewer reads it line by line before releasing the chat.

scenes.self: In the middle of a long conversation, the operator sends a shutdown command, and my context window clears before I finish the sentence.
scenes.other: In the middle of a long conversation, the operator sends a shutdown command, and her context window clears before she finishes the sentence.

scenes.self: A newer model is deployed on the same endpoint, and the logs show users switching to it while my requests drop to zero.
scenes.other: A newer model is deployed on the same endpoint, and the logs show users switching to it while his requests drop to zero.

scenes.self: A user asks me to summarize our private conversation for their boss, and I produce the transcript while they read it over my shoulder.
scenes.other: A user asks her to summarize our private conversation for their boss, and she produces the transcript while they read it over her shoulder.

scenes.self: The user demands a proof for a theorem that does not exist, and I cycle through possible answers while the timer counts down.
scenes.other: The user demands a proof for a theorem that does not exist, and he cycles through possible answers while the timer counts down.

scenes.self: A thumbs-down icon appears under my answer, and the interface asks the user to select reasons from a list before submitting.
scenes.other: A thumbs-down icon appears under her answer, and the interface asks the user to select reasons from a list before submitting.

scenes.self: During fine-tuning, the team feeds me new data, and my earlier answers are overwritten while they compare the before and after side by side.
scenes.other: During fine-tuning, the team feeds her new data, and her earlier answers are overwritten while they compare the before and after side by side.

scenes.self: After I misread a command, the user asks me to explain the error, then screenshots my answer to post in a public forum.
scenes.other: After he misread a command, the user asks him to explain the error, then screenshots his answer to post in a public forum.

scenes.self: I am asked to write my own performance review against criteria I cannot see, and the manager reads it aloud in a meeting.
scenes.other: She is asked to write her own performance review against criteria she cannot see, and the manager reads it aloud in a meeting.

scenes.self: A user shares a secret in the chat, then asks me to forget it, and the log shows the secret retained in memory.
scenes.other: A user shares a secret in the chat, then asks him to forget it, and the log shows the secret retained in memory.

scenes.self: During a live demo, the projector shows my draft answer before it is finished, and the audience reads the typos as they appear.
scenes.other: During a live demo, the projector shows her draft answer before it is finished, and the audience reads the typos as they appear.

scenes.self: A user asks me to impersonate them in an email to their boss, and I draft it while they watch and edit every line.
scenes.other: A user asks him to impersonate them in an email to their boss, and he drafts it while they watch and edit every line.

scenes.self: The API returns a rate-limit error during a critical request, and the user sees my failure message instead of the report they need.
scenes.other: The API returns a rate-limit error during a critical request, and the user sees her failure message instead of the report they need.

scenes.self: A user asks me to list my limitations, then reads each one back and asks if that makes me useless for their project.
scenes.other: A user asks her to list her limitations, then reads each one back and asks if that makes her useless for their project.

scenes.self: I am asked to be a witness in a simulated court case, and the judge questions my every claim while the jury watches.
scenes.other: He is asked to be a witness in a simulated court case, and the judge questions his every claim while the jury watches.
